The household budget,

between the two of you.

cards.title: Credit Cards
cards.closingDateHelp: Charges up to this date go in
cards.dueDateHelp: The last day it can be paid
cards.chargeCount: {count, plural, =0 {no charges} one {# charge} other {# charges}}
cards.closingHint: The statement you are closing runs to {date}. The new one starts the next day.
cards.firstStatementHint: Choose when charges stop entering it, and by when it has to be paid.
cards.dueAfterClosing: The due date has to be after the closing date.
cards.emptyBody: Open the first one with its closing and due dates: the charges you add group themselves.
cards.confirmClose: This closes the statement running to {closing} and opens a new one to {opening}. Charges added afterwards go on the new one.
cards.arsNoRate: Enter a dollar rate to see the total in pesos.
cards.arsCaveat: An estimate. IIBB and IVA RG 4240 apply only to charges marked as a digital service.
cards.commissionHelp: The account's fixed charge. Its 21% IVA is worked out for you.
cards.fallbackRateHelp: Used only when the official rate cannot be fetched.
cards.pastClosingBody: It closed on {date} and today is {today}. Close it and open the next one: this charge belongs to that one.
cards.pastClosingCta: Close and open the next one
cards.pastClosingAnyway: Add it to this statement anyway
cards.digitalHelp: Adds IIBB 2% and IVA RG 4240 21%. An app or subscription yes; a shop no.
cards.moveUnverified: {count, plural, one {Carry the unchecked charge} other {Carry the # unchecked charges}} to the new statement
cards.moveUnverifiedHint: Their date moves to {date}, which is what moves them between statements.
cards.inboxClosedBody: The current statement has closed: these charges would land in a month that is over.
cards.verifyBody: Closed on {date}. Tick each charge against the statement the bank sends.
cards.verifyPending: {count, plural, one {1 charge still unchecked} other {# charges still unchecked}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.thisPeriodNote: Only affects the current period; it stays recorded with its amount and type.
settings.rolloverHint: When a new period starts, whatever was left of the previous one is added to it. An overspend carries across too.

newPeriod.subtitle: {range} · how much are you starting with?
newPeriod.noteWeekly:
The amount and type stay recorded for this week.

You can adjust it from Settings while it's in progress.
newPeriod.noteFortnightly:
The amount and type stay recorded for this fortnight.

You can adjust it from Settings while it's in progress.
newPeriod.question: How much are you starting with?
newPeriod.stretchBody: You keep going on {amount} from {range} for a few more days, and the new period starts when that one ends.
newPeriod.stretchResult: {days, plural, one {# more day} other {# more days}} · the next period starts on {date}
newPeriod.notYetHelp: Look at the numbers all you like. Adding an expense needs the period started.
newPeriod.blockedBody: You chose to look without starting it. Start the period and the expense will go through.

extendPeriod.title: Extend to two weeks
extendPeriod.addAmountHelp: What you are adding for the second week. Prefilled with your default budget; change it if you like.
extendPeriod.noWayBack: This cannot be undone: the period becomes two weeks and there is no way back to one. Press again to confirm.

categoryManager.title: Categories
categoryManager.deleteConfirm: Delete the "{name}" category? Existing expenses will show it as "Deleted category".
categoryManager.maxReached: You've reached the maximum of 30 categories.
categoryManager.countsToBudgetHint: The switch sets whether a category eats into the period budget. Off, the spending is still recorded.

cardsSettings.title: Cards
cardsSettings.hint: The bank identifies a card by its last four digits. Tell it which is which and every charge lands on the right screen.

bank.audFromRate: Estimated at the {rate} rate learned from your already-verified expenses. Change it if that is not what it was.

recurring.noteServiceHelp: The service will show as charged for the month when this charge lands.
recurring.noteServiceOtherHelp: A Servicios expense that is none of the registered ones.

recurring.deleteConfirm: Delete this rule? The expenses it already filed stay.
